headline: Six Fronts Intensify as Bases Swap Hands
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the tempo of strategic‑base turnover has sharpened on the six hottest sectors. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theater, logging twenty‑seven ownership changes in the past day; Colonial dead have risen to 158,223 and Warden dead to 174,233, with Colonial casualties now cooling while Warden losses and enlistments accelerate. Linn Mercy still drives heavy fighting around Lathair, recording thirteen flips, 50,177 Colonial and 61,548 Warden casualties, and a sharp acceleration in Warden losses and recruitment despite a modest cooling of Colonial casualties. Stonecradle’s activity has risen to eleven flips, Colonial casualties reaching 40,526 and Warden 48,282, both casualty streams now accelerating while enlistments hold steady. Mooring County holds at eleven flips but shows a steep 24‑hour rise of 2,933 Colonial and 2,621 Warden dead, with all rate trends accelerating. Fishermans Row has slipped to eight flips, its Colonial losses modest at forty‑six while Warden losses climb to one‑thirty‑five and enlistments continue to cool. Stlican Shelf records eight flips, casualties climbing to 50,655 Colonial and 56,038 Warden, the latest hour showing cooling casualties but accelerating enlistments. Quiet northern Warden‑held sectors and deep Colonial interiors remain static, reporting no ownership changes.
